subject: Recap: SOC 2 + audit-log retention discussion (next steps)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jmills@novapay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: SOC 2 + audit-log retention discussion (next steps)

Jordan — thanks for taking the time this morning. Quick written recap so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps. If anything below doesn't match your view please flag.

Pain points & context
- Auditability: NovaPay needs per-request audit logs (immutable export) for regulator review and internal investigations.
- Retention policy: default retention is 90 days for app-level logs; you need 12–24 months for selected event types.
- DPA/compliance: legal wants a DPA clause for log retention and subprocessor mapping.
- Pen test evidence: external pen test window and confirmation of remediation cadence are gating for go-live.

What Redwood can provide (high level)
- SOC 2 Type II report (shared under NDA / restricted access).
- Audit-log export options: daily S3 export + one-click on-demand exports; configurable retention buckets per event type.
- Data retention and deletion controls exposed in Private/Dedicated deployment; hosted plans have configurable retention policies.
- Pen-test artifacts: redaction-friendly summary + remediation timeline; we can coordinate redaction for any customer-sensitive data.

Immediate next steps we discussed
1) Redwood: send evidence checklist + SOC2 sharing flow (Aditya) — by EOD 3/20.
2) NovaPay: share the DDQ + specific event types and retention windows (Jordan) — by 3/23.
3) Security call to map event taxonomy and retention buckets (30 min) — propose week of 3/23; Irene to lead technical mapping.
4) Pen test window: NovaPay to confirm preferred dates; Redwood to confirm scope and NDA (Sam / Security).

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)]

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the mapping call and drop the evidence pack link.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Aditya — quick clarifications after reading your recap: 

• Retention exceptions: For a subset of high-risk events (fraud alerts, dispute evidence) we need 24 months and an ability to flag them as long-lived — can Redwood support per-event retention overrides?
• Export fidelity: Our forensics team wants proof that export includes original request/response IDs and timestamps; will that be part of your S3 schema?
• Pen test: we run coordinated pen tests 4/12–4/18. Can Redwood commit an engineer to support evidence collection and remediation triage the week after (4/19–4/23)?

I attached the DDQ for reference. Two asks: please share the SOC2 delivery method (S3 vs secure viewer behind NDA) and a starter DPA.

Best,
Jordan

Following the customer thread — tagging internal owners and proposed delivery timeline. Internal only.

Action owner breakdown (internal)
- SOC2 report delivery: Neha to coordinate NDA and transfer (deliverable: SOC2 Type II redacted PDF) — target 3/24 for NDA sent, 3/29 for delivery.
- Audit-log export spec: Priyom to produce S3 schema + sample export (deliverable: auditlog-export-spec.md, sample-csv) — target 3/26.
- Retention overrides: Product infra (Irene + Priyom) to scope per-event retention keys and admin UI changes for Dedicated deployments; hosted options documented as config flags (deliverable: retention-options.md) — scope doc by 3/27.
- Pen test support: Assign an on-call engineer (1 day) post-window for evidence pulls + remediation notes (deliverable: pen-test-support-runbook) — confirm by 3/23.

Notes / constraints
- We can provide per-event retention overrides in Dedicated and Private within current roadmap; hosted customers can be configured but may require a short contract addendum for retention >365 days.
- Export fidelity: our S3 export includes request_id, event_type, user_id (hashed), timestamp, and a reference to stored payload — full response bodies are available for paid retention add-ons; will confirm sample schema (Priyom).
- SOC2 sharing: prefer secure viewer for initial share; can do S3 transfer under NDA if customer requires offline copy.

Attachments: [Attachment: retention-policy-summary.pdf (PDF, 8KB)]

Irene

- Exports: Priyom will deliver S3 export schema and a sample export file 3/26. Exports include request_id and timestamps; full response bodies are available as an add-on.
- Pen test coverage: Redwood commits 1 engineer on-call for triage the week of 4/19–4/23. Confirm that window and we’ll lock it in.
